item.title: Weather didn't stop champs from going ahead
item.description: Southern Stars performing their display. Photo: Morgan Fraser The annual Marching Otago Championships were held at the Edgar Centre in the weekend.

item.title: Luxon backtracks on Iran
item.description: Prime Minister Christopher Luxon. Photo: RNZ The Prime Minister has admitted he "misspoke" when he said New Zealand supported "any actions" to prevent Iran having nuclear weapons.

item.title: Thousands sign 'Commissioner for Animals' petition
item.description: Animal protection organisations delivered the petition to Parliament today. Photo: Supplied / SAFE NZ By Monique Steele of RNZ Warning: Images in this article may be distressing for some people. More than 31,000 New Zealanders want an independent 'Commissioner for Animals' to improve welfare for companion and farmed animals.

item.title: Luxury brands shut Middle East stores
item.description: Luxury stores in Bahrain and other places in the Middle East have been closed. Photo: ruelleruelle/UCG/Universal Images Group via Getty Images In Dubai and other major Middle Eastern shopping hubs, many stores are closed or operating with a skeleton staff as the escalating conflict in the region causes chaos for businesses and travel.

item.title: All Blacks Sevens coach out of tour due to visa issues
item.description: Tomasi Cama. File photo: Getty Images The All Black Sevens side will head to the New York and Vancouver legs of the World Sevens Series without head coach Tomasi Cama.
